notes:
1.6.0
- AI detector now uses a trained model that runs on your PC (trained on ~75,000 human and AI samples from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Llama and more), blended with the pattern algorithm
- Shows the model and algorithm scores separately
- Fewer false grammar flags (quotes, the letter i, rare words)
- MAX mode cleanup: far fewer filler openers (no more 'Truth be told... As it happens...' everywhere), no repeated fillers, no sentence-end 'in truth', no 'by me' passives, no broken 'as well as' clauses, no split fragments
- Fixed idioms like 'at first glance' and 'can't believe' getting mangled
history:
1.5.0
- New AI detector tab: scores how AI-like text reads (all algorithms, offline) and highlights AI-style phrases
- Grammar, spelling and punctuation checker with a list of every issue
- Open Pangram button for a stronger second opinion
- Notice that re-running the rewriter on the same text (outside of Passes) may give unwanted results

1.4.0
- New MAX mode: rebuilds whole sentences (cause/effect flips, concessions, cleft sentences, list reordering, extra splits)
- MAX always does at least 10 passes, then keeps going while the run is under 5 seconds
- Progress bar for long runs
- Success-rate labels under each strength
- Fixed repeated or dangling phrases like "in addition" at sentence ends

1.3.0
- Built-in grammar tagger (trained on a million-word corpus): knows nouns from verbs before swapping, picks exact verb tenses
- About 1,700 more vetted synonyms
- Flips sentences between active and passive, moving facts and numbers around ("The factory built 500 cars" -> "500 cars were built by the factory")
- Wanders: avoids the swaps and sentence shapes it used on recent presses, and each press gets its own style
- Update tab: download progress bar, full version history, Copy ID, revoked-key list, forced updates for unsupported versions
- New recycle icon

1.2.0
- Passes box (1-1000) that never undoes or repeats a change
- About 600 more words, rare connector swaps

1.1.0
- Much stronger offline rewriting and sentence rearranging
- Removed the Claude engine

1.0.1
- Windows version info, removed brand text

1.0.0
- First release
